stories.headline: Patreon stops asking AI bots not to scrape — and starts blocking them
stories.dek: Patreon is strengthening its defenses against AI scraping by working with Cloudflare to block bots that train AI models on creators’ content without permission. The move marks a shift away from relying on websites using robots.txt alone to actively block unauthorized AI training.
